newsitem.title: USA: IBM seen pulling Dow lower at New York opening.
newsitem.headline: IBM seen pulling Dow lower at New York opening.

text.p: Weakness in shares of International Business Machines Corp could pull the Dow Jones Industrial Average lower at the start of trade on Thursday, following Wednesday's 94-point drop, the third sharp selloff in four days.
IBM shares were down in London following a Wall Street Journal article saying that analysts were cutting their earnings estimates for Big Blue in 1997.
Otherwise, analysts said, the market's correction appeared to be tailing off, with the biggest hurdle left for Friday -- the March employment report.
This is expected to give clues on whether the U.S. Federal Reserve will raise interest rates again in a pre-emptive strike against inflation.
